mapper.select: WITH U AS ( SELECT USER_SEQ FROM ADM_USER_MST WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{user_id} AND NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ), UG AS ( SELECT GU.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ FROM ADM_AUTH_GROUP_USER GU JOIN U ON U.USER_SEQ = GU.USER_SEQ WHERE NVL(GU.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ), G_MENU AS ( SELECT AM.MENU_SEQ, MAX(NVL(AM.PERM_LVL, 0)) AS PERM_LVL FROM ADM_AUTH_MENU AM JOIN UG ON UG.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ = AM.AUTH_GROUP_SEQ WHERE NVL(AM.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY AM.MENU_SEQ ), U_EX AS ( SELECT AU.MENU_SEQ, MAX(CASE WHEN AU.ACCESS_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DENY_YN, MAX(CASE WHEN AU.ACCESS_YN = 'Y' THEN NVL(AU.PERM_LVL, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS ALLOW_LVL FROM ADM_AUTH_USER AU JOIN U ON U.USER_SEQ = AU.USER_SEQ GROUP BY AU.MENU_SEQ ), ALLOW_MENU AS ( SELECT M.MENU_SEQ, GREATEST(NVL(GM.PERM_LVL, 0), NVL(UE.ALLOW_LVL, 0)) AS PERM_LVL FROM ADM_MENU_MST M LEFT JOIN G_MENU GM ON GM.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ LEFT JOIN U_EX UE ON UE.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ WHERE NVL(M.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(UE.DENY_YN, 0) = 0 AND (NVL(GM.PERM_LVL, 0) > 0 OR NVL(UE.ALLOW_LVL, 0) > 0) ), TREE_MENU AS ( SELECT DISTINCT M.MENU_SEQ FROM ADM_MENU_MST M START WITH M.MENU_SEQ IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM ALLOW_MENU) CONNECT BY PRIOR M.UP_MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ ) SELECT M.MENU_SEQ, M.UP_MENU_SEQ, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL, NVL(M.SORT_ORD, 0) AS SORT_ORD, NVL(A.PERM_LVL, 0) AS PERM_LVL, M.MENU_TYPE_CD, M.ICON_CLASS FROM ADM_MENU_MST M JOIN TREE_MENU T ON T.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ LEFT JOIN ALLOW_MENU A ON A.MENU_SEQ = M.MENU_SEQ WHERE NVL(M.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL(M.SORT_ORD, 0), M.MENU_SEQ

SELECT MENU_SEQ, UP_MENU_SEQ, MENU_NM, MENU_URL, MENU_TYPE_CD, ICON_CLASS, NVL(SORT_ORD, 0) AS SORT_ORD, NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN FROM ADM_MENU_MST WHERE NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORD, 0), MENU_SEQ
